units.source_text: ……住持写信告诉我：母亲准备在父亲一周年忌辰的前一天来金阁借住一宿，并已得到允许了。

en.t: ... The prior wrote to tell me that my mother planned to come to the Golden Pavilion and stay for one night on the day before the first anniversary of my father's death, and that permission had already been granted.

units.source_text: 住持让我在忌辰当天也向学校请假。

en.t: The prior told me to ask the school for leave on the anniversary day as well.

units.source_text: 我每天都得参加义务劳动，忌辰头一天我想到即将返回鹿苑寺，心情就沉重起来。

en.t: Every day I had to take part in compulsory labor, and on the day before the anniversary, when I thought that I would soon return to Rokuonji, my heart grew heavy.
